FIX_1_coordinate_value_bearing_leaves.basis: Governed EMPIRICAL_POSITION_COORDINATE leaves already exist in the discovery owner. C1 previously excluded them from the value-bearing witness relation. The correction adds the existing leaf kind and retains exact leaf type/operator/value plus owner-native semantic-ref matching.

FIX_2_discovery_fact_by_winning_predicat.basis: Discovery receipts can carry baseline and candidate facts. Positional `fact_refs[0]` is not a semantic selector; exact equality of fact.condition_predicate_ref with the receipt winning predicate is.

FIX_3_recursive_lineage_ancestry_refs.basis: The public recursive_parent_atom writes the prior handoff ref into owner-native atom ancestry_refs. Closing over those retained refs is required for a real depth-two lineage and does not invent ancestry.

distinct_blocker.effect: Prevents approval of the generalized C1-02 exact witness/relation law.

c1_01_preservation.bounded_test_change: Signature whitelist expanded to include discovery_result, discovery_receipt_ref, recursive_handoff; this is compatible with C1-02 extension and does not weaken the no-preconstructed-evidence guard.

wider_regression.comparison_method: exact failing/erroring node-ID probe across corrected head, Kimi return, accepted C1-01 baseline
